title: Spectral input systems of brazilian bees
journal: conference abstract (Reunião Anual da FeSBE, Caxambu, as main's sweep-79 reading gives it); University of São Paulo repository record
why: Nannotrigona, receptor_classes, colour_vision and spectral_range_nm: the top hit of the web search "Nannotrigona spectral sensitivity". The abstract reports intracellular recordings of spectral sensitivity in the photoreceptors of 12 stingless-bee species and finds ultraviolet, blue and green receptors in all of them and no red receptor. Main read the repository page (sweep-79:3, corrected as recheck-11-fixed:13) and logged three receptor classes for Paratrigona, quoting only the end of the species list ("Frieseomelitta, Lestrimellita limão, Partamona subnuda e Schwarziana quadripuntacta", as printed), so whether a Nannotrigona is among the 12 is unseen. If it is, the abstract gives the genus its receptor classes, a trichromatic set (main files such a set under colour_vision for Euglossa dilemma) and an ultraviolet receptor near 340 nm; its peaks are means over the 12 species, so it gives no lambda_max_nm of one species. Title and year from the search result; not opened in this round. Main's corrected row gives the repository's generated citation, which names four authors and may be alphabetical, so the author field stays empty here.
get: open repository page: https://repositorio.usp.br/item/000884920 (main's sweep-79 reading opened it)
